## Summary

Explain the problem, approach and affected profiles.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Clearly identify checks not run or blocked by upstream availability.

## Checklist

- [ ] Reviewed and updated README.md, assessment.md and changelog.md.
- [ ] Added or updated tests when behavior changes.
- [ ] Preserved profile boundaries, upstream attribution and generated subscription URLs.
- [ ] Used descriptive links, logical headings and text alternatives where needed.
- [ ] Removed secrets, private domains and identifying logs.
